stem: What revision, if any, should be made in sentence 28?

options.label: A
options.text: I was determined until I had seen a shooting star to not doze off, but my eyes were growing weary.

options.label: B
options.text: I was determined to not doze off until I had seen a shooting star, but my eyes were growing weary.

options.label: C
options.text: I was determined to not doze off and determined to see a shooting star, but my eyes were growing weary.
